title: 「There is no such thing as X」句
titleZh: 「There is no such thing as X」表示「根本沒有 X 這回事」
titleEn: There is no such thing as X

source.file: Sentence Structure 250 - 「There is no such thing as X」表示「根本沒有 X 這回事」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered one lower than this system lesson ID because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: There + be + no such thing as + X

formulas.formula: There is no such thing as + X
There was no such thing as + X
There will be no such thing as + X
There can / could / may be no such thing as + X
In reality / In practice, there is no such thing as + X
Subject + realised / accepted / argued that + there is no such thing as + X
There is no such thing as + a noun phrase + that / which + clause

formulas.labelZh: 配合 as if 或 as though
formulas.formula: Subject + acts as if / as though + there were such a thing as + X

meaning.zh: 用來強烈表示某事物、概念或理想狀態根本不存在，亦可否定一種不切實際的假設。

rules.zh: 必須保留完整固定表達 no such thing as；as 是不可缺少的一部分。
rules.en: Keep the complete fixed expression no such thing as. The word as is essential.

rules.zh: thing 在這個固定句型中使用單數形式。
rules.en: Use the singular noun thing in this fixed structure.

rules.zh: 情態動詞後使用 be，例如 can be、could be 或 may be。
rules.en: Use be after a modal verb, as in can be, could be or may be.

rules.zh: 不要加入雙重否定；no 已經提供否定意思。
rules.en: Do not add a double negative. The word no already supplies the negative meaning.

rules.zh: be 動詞須配合原句時態，可使用 is、was、will be 或完成式形式。
rules.en: Match the tense of the original sentence by changing the form of be when necessary.

rules.zh: 這是語氣強烈的表達；如只是否定某個範圍，須加入限定詞以避免過度概括。
rules.en: This is a strong statement. Add a limiting phrase when the non-existence claim applies only within a particular scope.

benefits.zh: 能直接否定不切實際或根本不存在的想法。
benefits.en: It rejects an unrealistic or non-existent idea directly.

benefits.zh: 能把較長的解釋濃縮成清晰而有力的一句。
benefits.en: It shortens a longer explanation into one clear and forceful sentence.

benefits.zh: 有助糾正常見誤解或錯誤信念。
benefits.en: It helps correct common misunderstandings and mistaken beliefs.

benefits.zh: 能建立較現實的期望，避免把理想狀態當作必然。
benefits.en: It encourages realistic expectations instead of treating an ideal condition as guaranteed.

benefits.zh: 既適合簡短回答，也能放進較長而完整的論述。
benefits.en: It works in both short responses and more developed arguments.

benefits.zh: 固定框架容易記憶，亦容易按時態和語境調整。
benefits.en: Its memorable frame is easy to adapt for different tenses and contexts.

en: Rewrite each sentence using no such thing as.
Preserve the original meaning, tense, degree of certainty and point of view.
The target expression may appear at the beginning, in the middle or later in the answer.
